title: Implement auto start stop pre-roll and post-roll controller
description:
Create AutoRecordController that monitors an audio level signal and drives recording start/stop with configurable thresholds, hold time, pre-roll, and post-roll.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/recording/ for the existing recorder interface and ring-buffer API that pre-roll will read from.
- Any existing threshold or level-monitoring helpers.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. AutoRecordController exposes start/stop threshold (dBFS), hold time (ms), pre-roll duration (ms), and post-roll duration (ms) as configurable properties.
2. feedLevel(float peakLinear) is called from the GUI/metering thread (never from the PipeWire realtime callback) and drives a simple state machine: Idle → Armed → Recording → PostRoll → Idle.
3. Transition from Idle to Armed occurs when the peak exceeds startThreshold for a debounce window (≥2 consecutive calls) to avoid threshold chatter.
4. Pre-roll: on transition to Recording, emit a signal carrying the pre-roll duration so the recorder can flush its ring-buffer history into the file.
5. Post-roll: when the level drops below stopThreshold, enter PostRoll state and continue recording for the configured post-roll duration before emitting a stop signal.
6. Hold time: if the level rises above startThreshold again during PostRoll, return to Recording without re-triggering pre-roll.
7. No file I/O, no PipeWire calls, no blocking synchronization inside this class.
8. Use Q_OBJECT, signals/slots for integration. Expose an enum State { Idle, Armed, Recording, PostRoll } and a stateChanged signal.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/automation/AutoRecordController.hpp declares AutoRecordController with Q_OBJECT, State enum, feedLevel slot, configurable threshold/hold/pre-roll/post-roll properties, and stateChanged signal
